text:
I estimated the items from the photo. The plate holds two slices of toast, a poached egg, two butter portions, a latte-style coffee with milk, and water.

Toast: two slices of multigrain bread, about 35 g each, come to roughly 170 kcal. That is about 8 g protein, 30 g carbs and 2 g fat.

Egg: one poached egg is about 70 kcal, with 6 g protein, 0.5 g carbs and 5 g fat.

Butter: two portions of about 7 g each come to roughly 100 kcal, with 11 g fat.

Coffee: a milky coffee of about 200 ml is roughly 60 kcal, with 3 g protein, 5 g carbs and 3 g fat.

Total served: about 400 kcal, with 17 g protein, 36 g carbs and 21 g fat.

I can't tell from a before-meal photo how much will be left. I assumed a small amount, about 40 kcal, which would be part of the butter or some toast. That leaves about 360 kcal eaten, with about 15 g protein, 33 g carbs and 19 g fat.
